STS2_LINNEA_CARD_LINNEA_STRIKE.title: Strike
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_LINNEA_DEFEND.title: Defend
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_LUMI.title: Lumi
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_LUMI.description: Cannot normally be played. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_ORE.title: Ore
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_LUMI_GO.title: Go, Lumi!
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_LUMI_GO.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Lumi in your hand can be played this turn.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_TRAINING_BEGINS.title: Training Begins!
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_PINCER_ATTACK.title: Pincer Attack
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_PINCER_ATTACK.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Play Lumi from your hand against that enemy.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_HAMMER_STRIKE.title: Hammer Strike
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_PREDICTIVE_STRIKE.title: Predictive Strike
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_MINING_STRIKE.title: Mining Strike
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_MINING_STRIKE.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Add 1 Ore to your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_DISCOVER_THE_VEIN.title: Discover the Vein
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_DISCOVER_THE_VEIN.descr: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Add {Ore:diff()} Ore to your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_PRECISE_STRIKE.title: Precise Strike
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_DIG_DEEP.title: Dig Deep
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_LUMI_SHOUT.title: Lumi, Yahoo!
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_LUMI_SHOUT.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. [gold]Encourage[/gold] {Encourage:diff()}. Return Lumi to your hand. It can be played this turn.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CALL_A_FRIEND.title: Call a Friend
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CALL_A_FRIEND.descripti: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Discard 1 card. Return Lumi to your hand from anywhere.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CAUTIOUS_ACTION.title: Cautious Action
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_METICULOUS_PLAN.title: Meticulous Plan
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_FULL_PREPARATION.title: Full Preparation
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_FULL_PREPARATION.descri: [gold]Encourage[/gold] equal to your current Block. If Lumi is in your hand, it can be played this turn; otherwise return it to your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_USE_EVERYTHING.title: Use Everything
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_USE_EVERYTHING.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you have no Ore in hand, add 1 Ore to your hand, then deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} more damage.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_DAILY_PRACTICE.title: Daily Practice
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_DAILY_PRACTICE.descript: At the start of each turn, [gold]Encourage[/gold] {Effect:diff()}.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SOLID_FOUNDATION.title: Solid Foundation
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_HARD_STUDY.title: Hard Study
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SELF_RELIANCE.title: Self Reliance
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SELF_RELIANCE.descripti: At the end of your turn, gain {Effect:diff()} Block if Lumi is not in your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_UNSPOKEN_BOND.title: Unspoken Bond
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_UNSPOKEN_BOND.descripti: At the end of your turn, if Lumi is in your hand, automatically play it against a random enemy. Otherwise return Lumi to your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_HAPPY_TOGETHER.title: Happy Together!
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_HAPPY_TOGETHER.descript: At the start of your turn, gain {Block:diff()} Block and heal that much.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_FOREKNOWLEDGE_FORM.desc: Gain {InitialForeknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold]. After you play the first card each turn, gain {Foreknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold], then halve your current Foreknowledge (round down) and heal HP equal to the amount lost.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_WORTH_EVERY_STONE.title: Worth Every Stone
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_WORTH_EVERY_STONE.descr: Whenever a Status leaves your hand, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_GATHERING_STONES.title: Gathering Stones
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_GATHERING_STONES.descri: At the end of your turn, gain {Block:diff()} Block per Status card in your hand. If you have no Status cards, add 1 Ore to your discard pile.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_DISCERNING_EYE.title: Discerning Eye
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_DISCERNING_EYE.descript: The first time you draw a Status or Colorless card each turn, choose a card to Exhaust. Then draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_GROWING_BRAVER.title: Growing Braver
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_GROWING_BRAVER.descript: Whenever you Exhaust a card, return Lumi to your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_OVERFLOWING_JOY.title: Overflowing Joy
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_OVERFLOWING_JOY.descrip: During your turn, whenever a card enters your discard pile, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_STRONG_MEMORY.title: Strong Memory
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_STRONG_MEMORY.descripti: At the start of your turn, if you have at least 5 [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold], gain 1 Energy.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_ANALOGY.title: Analogy
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_ANALOGY.description: After shuffling, deal damage to ALL enemies equal to the size of your draw pile.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_DAILY_ACCUMULATION.desc: During your turn, [gold]Encourage[/gold] 1 for each [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold] gained.
Whenever a Status enters your discard pile, gain {Foreknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold].
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_ALL_FORESEEN.title: All Foreseen
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_ALL_FORESEEN.descriptio: For every {Spend:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold] spent, generate an Ore in your discard pile.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CLAIRVOYANCE.title: Clairvoyance
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CLAIRVOYANCE.descriptio: At the end of your turn, gain Block equal to your [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold].
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_IMMOVABLE.title: Immovable
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_IMMOVABLE.description: Gain 1 Intangible. Whenever Lumi deals damage, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CONTINUOUS_HAMMER.title: Continuous Hammer
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CONTINUOUS_HAMMER.descr: Lumi now attacks twice. Return Lumi to your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_WEAKNESS_SURVEY.title: Weakness Survey
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_WEAKNESS_SURVEY.descrip: Before Lumi attacks, apply {Vulnerable:diff()} Vulnerable to its targets.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SPOKEN_OMEN.title: Spoken Omen
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SPOKEN_OMEN.description: At the start of your turn, if an enemy intends to attack, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies next turn; otherwise gain {Block:diff()} Block next turn.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_COORDINATED_COVER.title: Coordinated Cover
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_COORDINATED_COVER.descr: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Discard a card. If you discarded Lumi, gain {ExtraBlock:diff()} more Block.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_READY_TO_GO.title: Ready to Go
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_READY_TO_GO.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. At the start of your next turn, [gold]Encourage[/gold] {Encourage:diff()}.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_AUGUR_VISION.title: Augur Vision
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_AUGUR_VISION.descriptio: Draw {Cards:diff()}. Gain {Foreknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold]. The first time you gain Block next turn, gain {Foreknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold].
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_TURN_THE_TIDE.title: Turn the Tide
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_TURN_THE_TIDE.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Costs 1 less for every {Threshold:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold] you have.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_KEEN_REFLEX.title: Keen Reflex
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_KEEN_REFLEX.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. At the start of your next turn, if an enemy intends to attack, gain {NextBlock:diff()} Block.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_FLEETING_MOMENT.title: Fleeting Moment
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_FLEETING_MOMENT.descrip: Gain {Foreknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold]. At the start of your next turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to each enemy that does not intend to attack. For each attacking enemy, spend {Spend:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold] to Stun it.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_LIGHTNING_NERVES.title: Lightning Nerves
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_LIGHTNING_NERVES.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. The next time you Exhaust a card, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_FULL_ATTENTION.title: Full Attention
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_FULL_ATTENTION.descript: Draw {Cards:diff()}. If you drew a Skill, draw {ExtraCards:diff()} more.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_RAIN_OF_BLOWS.title: Rain of Blows
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_RAIN_OF_BLOWS.descripti: Exhaust the top card of your draw pile. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits:diff()} times. If it was a Skill, gain 1 Strength.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_BEYOND_FATE.title: Beyond Fate
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_BEYOND_FATE.description: Gain {Foreknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold]. View the cards you foresee and move any number to your discard pile.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_POLISH_THE_ROUGH.title: Polish the Rough
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_POLISH_THE_ROUGH.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Exhaust a Status or Curse from your hand to deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} more damage to ALL enemies.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_READ_THE_STONE.title: Read the Stone
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_READ_THE_STONE.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Draw {Cards:diff()}, then discard 1. If it was Ore, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_FEED_THE_ORE.title: Feed the Ore
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_FEED_THE_ORE.descriptio: Exhaust all Status and Curse cards in your hand. [gold]Encourage[/gold] {Encourage:diff()} for each card exhausted, then return Lumi to your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SUPPORTING_HAMMER.title: Supporting Hammer
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SUPPORTING_HAMMER.descr: If Lumi is in your hand, [gold]Encourage[/gold] {Encourage:diff()} and play it on the target. Otherwise return Lumi to your hand and [gold]Encourage[/gold] {RecallEncourage:diff()}.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_READ_THE_ATTACK.title: Read the Attack
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_READ_THE_ATTACK.descrip: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If an enemy intends to attack, gain {ExtraBlock:diff()} more Block.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_MOUNTAIN_OF_ORE.title: Mountain of Ore
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_MOUNTAIN_OF_ORE.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Generate an Ore in your hand, then generate an Ore in your draw pile per Ore in your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_REFRACT_LIGHT.title: Refract Light
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_REFRACT_LIGHT.descripti: Exhaust all Status and Curse cards in your hand. Choose a card in your hand. It gains 1 Replay for each Ore exhausted.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_FINE_SELECTION.title: Fine Selection
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_FINE_SELECTION.descript: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Exhaust the top card of your draw pile and generate 2 Ore in your hand. If it was a Status, draw 2.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_LAYERED_SELECTION.title: Layered Selection
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_LAYERED_SELECTION.descr: After drawing next turn, draw 1 per Status card in your hand. If this would fill your hand, discard all Ore first.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_BLESSING_IN_DISGUISE.de: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Whenever you would receive a debuff next turn, spend 3 [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold] to negate it and draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CAREFUL_CARVING.title: Careful Carving
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CAREFUL_CARVING.descrip: Draw {Cards:diff()} and discard those cards. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies per Status card discarded. Gain {Block:diff()} Block per non-Status card discarded.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_OVERDRAFT.title: Overdraft
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_OVERDRAFT.description: Draw {Cards:diff()}. Gain {Foreknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold]. At the start of your next turn, discard {Discard:diff()}.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_KNOW_YOUR_ENEMY.title: Know Your Enemy
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_KNOW_YOUR_ENEMY.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Halve each loss of HP during your next turn.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_ALL_IN.title: All In
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_ALL_IN.description: This turn, you take double damage. Lumi attacks ALL enemies and deals double damage. Return Lumi to your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_KEEN_SENSES.title: Keen Senses
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_KEEN_SENSES.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Gain {NextBlock:diff()} Block next turn.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_COUNTER_INITIATIVE.desc: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. At the start of your next turn, apply {Debuff:diff()} Weak and Vulnerable to attacking enemies.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_TRAVELING_GUARD.title: Traveling Guard
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_TRAVELING_GUARD.descrip: Gain {Block:diff()} Block, plus {ColorlessBlock:diff()} per Colorless card and {StatusBlock:diff()} per Status in your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_UNEASY_PREMONITION.desc: If the top card of your draw pile is a Status, heal {Heal:diff()}, Exhaust it, and gain 3 Energy. Otherwise draw 1, gain {Block:diff()} Block and 2 Energy.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_METAL_STORM.title: Metal Storm
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_METAL_STORM.description: Exhaust all Status cards in your hand. Deal {Damage:diff()}X damage for each card exhausted.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_BEYOND_FATE.selectionSc: Move any number of the cards you foresee to your discard pile.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_REFRACT_LIGHT.selection: Choose a card in your hand to gain Replay.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SACRIFICIAL_ASSAULT.des: Play Lumi from your hand twice on the target, remove all Encouragement, and Exhaust Lumi. At the start of your next turn, generate Lumi in your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_RELIABLE_SHIELD.title: Reliable Shield
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_RELIABLE_SHIELD.descrip: {IfUpgraded:show:Return Lumi to your hand. |}Play Lumi from your hand on the target. Gain Block equal to the damage dealt.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_DEMONSTRATION.title: Demonstration
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_DEMONSTRATION.descripti: Deal damage equal to Lumi’s current damage value. At the end of your next turn, if Lumi is in your hand, [gold]Encourage[/gold] {Encourage:diff()}.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CHEER_ON.title: Cheer On
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CHEER_ON.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Foreknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold]. [gold]Encourage[/gold] {Encourage:diff()}. This combat, this card costs 1 more and all its effects double.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_GAZE_AHEAD.title: Gaze Ahead
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_GAZE_AHEAD.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Spend all [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold], adding {Increase:diff()} damage for each {Spend:diff()} spent.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_FLEETING_MIRAGE.title: Fleeting Mirage
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_FLEETING_MIRAGE.descrip: Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} Block, equal to your [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold]. Keep your Block at the start of your next turn. Until the start of your next turn, your [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold] is not reduced by drawing cards. When you gain [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold] next turn, return this card to your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SHARP_INSIGHT.title: Sharp Insight
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SHARP_INSIGHT.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Foreknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold]. If you lost no HP last turn, this card gains 1 Replay this combat.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_AVOID_THE_EDGE.title: Avoid the Edge
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_AVOID_THE_EDGE.descript: Discard 3 cards. Per total Energy cost, gain {CostForeknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold] and draw 1 next turn. Per Status, gain {StatusForeknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold] and 1 Energy next turn.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_GOLD_IN_THE_SAND.title: Gold in the Sand
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_GOLD_IN_THE_SAND.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. At combat victory, gain Gold equal to the damage dealt.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_COLLECT_BESTIARY.title: Collect Bestiary
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_COLLECT_BESTIARY.descri: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} more for each unique enemy defeated this run.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SURVIVAL_SKILLS.title: Survival Skills
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SURVIVAL_SKILLS.descrip: Move a card from your draw pile to your discard pile, then put a card from your discard pile on top of your draw pile.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_ONE_BURST.title: One Burst
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_ONE_BURST.description: The next time Lumi enters your hand, if it cannot be played, lose up to {Reduction:diff()} [gold]Encouragement[/gold] to enable it this turn. Then draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_REVERIE.title: Reverie
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_REVERIE.description: Spend 3 [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold] to [gold]Encourage[/gold] {Encourage:diff()}. If at least {Threshold:diff()} remain, spend 2 more and return this card to your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_ACCELERATE_THE_FUTURE.d: If you have less than 12 [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold], gain {Foreknowledge:diff()}. Otherwise draw {Cards:diff()} and discard at least 1 of those cards.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_BOLD_SPECULATION.title: Bold Speculation
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_BOLD_SPECULATION.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. At the start of your next turn, if you lost no HP, deal {NextDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies and draw 1. Otherwise gain 2 Weak and discard 1.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SIDE_BY_SIDE.title: Side by Side
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SIDE_BY_SIDE.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Draw {Cards:diff()}. Whenever Lumi deals damage, this card costs 0 for its next play.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_TRAIL_COMPANIONS.title: Trail Companions
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_TRAIL_COMPANIONS.descri: Another player draws {Cards:diff()}. If Lumi is in your hand, [gold]Encourage[/gold] {Encourage:diff()}. Otherwise return Lumi to your hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CHOOSE_WITH_CARE.title: Choose with Care
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CHOOSE_WITH_CARE.descri: Exhaust up to {Ores:diff()} Ore from your hand. Another player gains {Block:diff()} Block, plus {ExtraBlock:diff()} per Ore exhausted.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_WELL_PREPARED.title: Well Prepared
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_WELL_PREPARED.descripti: Gain {Foreknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold]. Another player draws 2 more next turn. If you have at least {Threshold:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold], they also gain 1 Energy next turn.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_WORLD_ROAMING.title: World Roaming
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_WORLD_ROAMING.descripti: After your first Lumi play each turn, all players gain {Block:diff()} Block. If it dealt unblocked damage, they each draw 1.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_AUGUR_GUIDANCE.title: Augur Guidance
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_AUGUR_GUIDANCE.descript: Spend up to {Foreknowledge:diff()} [gold]Foreknowledge[/gold] to view that many top cards of another player’s draw pile. Put up to {Cards:diff()} in their hand, preserving the order of the rest.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_ACCELERATE_THE_FUTURE.s: Discard at least 1 of the cards you just drew.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_CHOOSE_WITH_CARE.select: Exhaust up to the indicated number of Ore.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_AUGUR_GUIDANCE.selectio: Put up to the indicated number of cards in your ally’s hand.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SAPPHIRE_SEED_QUEST.des: Can be cultivated into a Sapphire Flower at a Rest Site.
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_SAPPHIRE_FLOWER.title: Sapphire Flower
STS2_LINNEA_CARD_POLISH_THE_ROUGH.select: Choose a Status or Curse to Exhaust.
